integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducible exact finite-algebra checks supplied. Self-review only; no independent review, validation, certification or proof assistant verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a fixed finite-dimensional multitype inverse-Gaussian subordinator with a nonsingular M-matrix, strictly positive immigration on all types and positive time. It describes exact cumulant signs and Lévy simultaneous-jump support, not the full joint Lévy density or an arbitrary multivariate inverse-Gaussian family. Historical priority remains uncertain in broader rooted-tree and first-passage literature.
title: Directed common-ancestor hypergraphs determine joint jumps of multitype inverse-Gaussian subordinators
